title: In Sojourners
excerpt: If you haven’t checked out Sojourners Magazine in a while, I have a cover story on American Exceptionalism, and Derek Flood has a tremendously important piece on violence in the Bible. Check it out here: http://sojo.net/magazine/2012/01/america-exceptional
